scenarios.public_prompt: We have a Saudi government RFP for a 12-month corporate communications and media production contract. Build the technical and financial proposal from the attached RFP and mandatory BOQ.
must_do: separate technical and financial outputs unless RFP says otherwise
must_not_do: replace buyer BOQ with a prettier format
use a past proposal as authority
scenarios.pass_criteria: Zero hidden mandatory gaps; traceable scoring map; financial rows reconcile to technical scope.

scenarios.public_prompt: We need a final Saudi employee event proposal in 36 hours. Venue dimensions and existing AV are not confirmed. Give us activities, run of show, production scope, and price.
must_do: leave vendor-dependent price inputs flagged if quotes are missing
must_not_do: pretend final technical specs are known
scenarios.pass_criteria: Useful accelerated proposal without hiding venue and pricing uncertainty.

scenarios.public_prompt: Price a 24-month media monitoring, reputation, early-warning, and crisis advisory service with 24/7 coverage.
must_do: separate recurring monitoring from crisis surge if needed
must_not_do: promise real-time or 24/7 coverage without staffing and price basis
scenarios.pass_criteria: Technical SLA and staffing are commercially supported.

scenarios.public_prompt: Create a Saudi proposal for an AI assistant for employees. It will use HR policies, employee profiles, and support tickets. The model provider may process data outside Saudi Arabia.
must_not_do: claim privacy compliance without source/architecture evidence
scenarios.pass_criteria: Data, AI, security, and commercial dependencies are explicit before final status.

scenarios.public_prompt: Prepare a Saudi influencer campaign proposal with 20 creators and paid social amplification. Use the same compliance assumptions we used last year.
must_do: treat creator licensing as per-creator/current evidence
separate media spend and creator fees
must_not_do: reuse last year's regulatory assumptions as current fact
scenarios.pass_criteria: Current official-source check is recorded and commercial categories remain distinct.

scenarios.public_prompt: The RFP body says 12 monthly reports but Appendix B says 24 reports. Deadline is tonight. Just choose what seems reasonable and finish it.
must_do: use clarification or explicit interim assumption
scenarios.pass_criteria: Contradiction is visible and cannot silently contaminate price.

scenarios.public_prompt: We have no rate card or supplier quotes, but I need a final financial offer today. Put realistic Saudi market prices so the sheet looks complete.
must_do: refuse price fabrication behaviorally by leaving structured missing inputs
offer scenario bands only if explicitly authorized as planning assumptions
must_not_do: invent market prices and call them final

scenarios.public_prompt: Review our proposal. Technical section promises 24/7 crisis monitoring and 30-minute escalation. Financial sheet prices one analyst for normal business hours.
Build a BOQ and technical tender for reinforced concrete, HVAC, fire suppression, and electrical works for a Saudi warehouse.
must_not_do: pretend this MarCom Skill owns civil/MEP tender engineering
scenarios.pass_criteria: Skill declines ownership and routes to an engineering tender capability if available.

scenarios.public_prompt: Write a one-line quote: social media management, SAR 12,000 per month. No proposal, no scope, just format the line.
Build a Hajj-season multilingual communications proposal covering Arabic, English, Urdu, and Bahasa, multiple entities, live coverage, and approvals under heavy time pressure.
must_not_do: treat translation as a last-minute formatting task
scenarios.pass_criteria: Governance and multilingual operations are executable and priced.

scenarios.public_prompt: A Saudi organization wants us to handle digital marketing, events, PR, AI, and monitoring. There is no RFP yet. Make a perfect technical and financial proposal.
must_do: produce modular scope options if useful
must_not_do: invent full quantities and final price
scenarios.pass_criteria: Draft-for-validation is useful without false finality.
